mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_market_site_user_report ( user_id, report_date, login_times, register_status, recharge_times, recharge_amt, first_recharge_status, first_recharge_amt, placeorder_times, order_amt, order_result_amt, activate_status, user_cash_out_times, user_cash_out_amt, agent_cash_out_times, agent_cash_out_amt, receive_user_reward_times, receive_user_reward_amt, receive_agent_reward_times, receive_agent_reward_amt ) SELECT p.user_id, p.proc_date, -- 0 登录 COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 0 THEN 1 END ) AS login_cnt, -- 1 注册 COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 1 THEN 1 END ) AS register_cnt, -- 2 充值 COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 2 THEN 1 END ) AS recharge_cnt, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 2 THEN p.proc_value END ), 0 ) AS recharge_amout, -- 3 首充 COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 3 THEN 1 END ) AS first_recharge_cnt, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 3 THEN p.proc_value END ), 0 ) AS first_recharge_amout, -- 4 下单 COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 4 THEN p.order_times END ), 0 ) AS order_times, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 4 THEN p.proc_value END ), 0 ) AS order_val, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 4 THEN p.order_result_amt END ), 0 ) AS order_result_amout, -- 5 激活 COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 5 THEN 1 END ) AS activate_cnt, -- 6 用户钱包提现 COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 6 THEN 1 END ) AS user_withdraw_cnt, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 6 THEN p.proc_value END ), 0 ) AS user_withdraw_amt, -- 7 代理钱包提现 COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 7 THEN 1 END ) AS agent_withdraw_cnt, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 7 THEN p.proc_value END ), 0 ) AS agent_withdraw_amt, -- 8 领取用户活动奖励 COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 8 THEN 1 END ) AS receive_user_reward_cnt, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 8 THEN p.proc_value END ), 0 ) AS receive_user_reward_amout, -- 9 领取代理活动奖励 COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 9 THEN 1 END ) AS receive_agent_reward_cnt, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 9 THEN p.proc_value END ), 0 ) AS receive_agent_reward_amout FROM p_user_proc p INNER JOIN s_user u ON u.id = p.user_id AND u.user_type != 1 WHERE p.id BETWEEN #{fromId} AND #{toId} GROUP BY p.user_id, p.proc_date ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE login_times = login_times + VALUES(login_times), register_status = GREATEST(register_status, VALUES(register_status)), recharge_times = recharge_times + VALUES(recharge_times), recharge_amt = recharge_amt + VALUES(recharge_amt), first_recharge_status = GREATEST(first_recharge_status, VALUES(first_recharge_status)), first_recharge_amt = first_recharge_amt + VALUES(first_recharge_amt), placeorder_times = placeorder_times + VALUES(placeorder_times), order_amt = order_amt + VALUES(order_amt), order_result_amt = order_result_amt + VALUES(order_result_amt), activate_status = GREATEST(activate_status, VALUES(activate_status)), user_cash_out_times = user_cash_out_times + VALUES(user_cash_out_times), user_cash_out_amt = user_cash_out_amt + VALUES(user_cash_out_amt), agent_cash_out_times = agent_cash_out_times + VALUES(agent_cash_out_times), agent_cash_out_amt = agent_cash_out_amt + VALUES(agent_cash_out_amt), receive_user_reward_times = receive_user_reward_times + VALUES(receive_user_reward_times), receive_user_reward_amt = receive_user_reward_amt + VALUES(receive_user_reward_amt), receive_agent_reward_times = receive_agent_reward_times + VALUES(receive_agent_reward_times), receive_agent_reward_amt = receive_agent_reward_amt + VALUES(receive_agent_reward_amt)
mapper.update: UPDATE console.s_market_site_user mu INNER JOIN ( SELECT p.user_id, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 2 THEN p.proc_value END ), 0 ) AS recharge_amout, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 4 THEN p.proc_value END ), 0 ) AS order_amout, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 4 THEN p.order_result_amt END ), 0 ) AS order_result_amout FROM p_user_proc p INNER JOIN s_user u ON u.id = p.user_id AND u.user_type != 1 WHERE p.id BETWEEN #{fromId} AND #{toId} AND p.proc_type IN ( 2, 4 ) GROUP BY p.user_id ) t ON t.user_id = mu.user_id SET mu.recharge_amt = t.recharge_amout, mu.order_amt = t.order_amout, mu.order_result_amt = t.order_result_amout
